outcome: The harness survives any console code page: every text I/O boundary in factory/scripts names its encoding explicitly per decision 0043 — diagnostics degrade gracefully, evidence fails loudly, digest paths stay bytes — with spawned workers contracted to UTF-8 and stdin read strictly. The convention is machine-enforced by check_encoding_hygiene (AST-based, value-validating, seeded self-tests) on every PR, and CI proves the flows under a forced non-UTF-8 locale on ubuntu and the real ANSI code page on Windows, including a non-cp1252 glyph round-tripping the delegation handoff.
